entities.summary: Gaozi, or Gao Buhai, was a Chinese philosopher during the Warring States period. Gaozi's teachings are no longer extant, but he was a contemporary of Mencius, and most of our knowledge about him comes from the Mencius book (6) titled "Gaozi".
